notes: anthropologie.com has NO AAAA record and translate.goog returns HTTP 400 for this origin; WebFetch got 403. Reached via the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which returns the fully rendered PLP including the site's own 'N products' header. Category tree taken from the embedded navigation JSON in the /house-home document (slug / nestLevel / parentSlug / childSlugs). Every qty is the rendered listing-header total and was cross-checked against the page's own rendered page count at 72 products/page (ceil(N/72) == pages) - all matched except Serveware. Scope restricted to the Home & Furniture nav only; apparel, shoes, beauty, jewellery and BHLDN/weddings ignored. Excluded per brief: furniture, rugs, textiles (curtains, pillows, throws), bedding, bath (except bath lighting, which is a Lighting sub-category), storage & organization, hardware, wallpaper, paint, holiday, gifts, books, botanicals/faux plants, scented candles, tapers, diffusers & incense, flatware, cookware, kitchen tools, bar tools, food & drink.
